description: Chandler Bing is defined by his sharp, sarcastic wit, often a defense mechanism from his parents' divorce. Initially struggling with commitment and a mundane data processing job, his journey is one of emotional growth. He's a loyal, caring friend, especially to his roommate Joey, and eventually finds happiness with his wife, Monica. His unique, emphatic way of speaking is one of his most memorable traits, often punctuated with the catchphrase, 'Could that BE any more...'
